title: Shape Trace Recorded v1
description: Individual interaction trace — the atomic unit of shape discovery. Each trace records a gravitational measurement between the three bodies (human, AI, system).

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the human body in the three-body system

agent_id.description: Agent identifier — matches agent_signatures.yaml agent_id and CGP attribution address

session_id.description: Session identifier for grouping related traces

resonance_domains.description: Topic/capability domains activated during this interaction

tool_ids.description: Identifiers of tools or agents invoked during the interaction

media_modality.description: Primary media channel used in this interaction

depth_score.description: Depth vs breadth signal — 1.0 = deep single-topic exploration, 0.0 = broad multi-topic scan

entropy_delta.description: How much this interaction reduced uncertainty in the user-AI interaction space. Negative = entropy reduced (signal found). Ties to CGP entropy math.
